Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.language

Interface CompiledAction

public interface CompiledAction
A compiled action.

The engine never executes one compiled action on two threads at once, as long as copy() returns a new object: each run executes its own copy, and the action the compiler returned is only copied, never executed. An action that several threads can execute at the same time returns itself from copy().

  • Method Details

    • execute

      void execute(ActionContext context)
      Executes the action, which changes ActionContext.output() in place. Variables it declares stay local to this execution. An exception it throws fails the rule with a RuleExecutionException, except a fatal Error, which run() rethrows unchanged.
      Parameters:
      context - The facts of the run and the output object

    • copy

      default CompiledAction copy()
      Returns an action for one run to execute. The engine calls it on the action the compiler returned, which no run executes, and may call it from several threads at once, so a copy must be built only from state that doesn't change, such as the source and what it was compiled with. By default, returns this action, which is right for an action that several threads can execute at the same time.
      Returns:
      A new copy, or this action if several threads can execute it at the same time. Throwing or returning null fails the run with a RuleExecutionException.
